applicable_questions: Test40 questions with at least one required-gold chunk
answer_metric: mean of the three frozen GPT-5.1 question-level component-balanced core reference-claim coverage scores
association: Spearman rank correlation across the original 114 question-system observations

significance_test.method: OLS on average ranks with question-clustered CR1 standard errors
significance_test.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the three exploratory retrieval-metric tests

bootstrap.rule: retain all three retrieval-system observations for every sampled question

coefficient_comparison: within-replicate differences between dependent Spearman correlations
full_retrieval_diagnostic: Spearman association between MRR and final-answer quality among observations with required_gold_recall@10 = 1
strict_matched_full_retrieval_diagnostic: descriptive system means for the seven questions on which all three systems had required_gold_recall@10 = 1
interpretation_limits: post hoc and descriptive, not causal
retrieval metrics are correlated and coefficient differences require paired uncertainty
full required-gold retrieval does not imply identical complete contexts
